# Alder Lane Community Garden: Work Day

Dear members,

Please join us at the garden for our autumn work day on **Saturday 14 November 2026, from 09:30 to 12:30**, as we prepare for winter.

Please bring gloves. The club will provide soup, and a tool sharpener will be there at **10:00**.

The water will be shut off for the winter during the work day. The garden closes at the end of November.

Thank you for helping care for our garden. We look forward to seeing you there!

The Committee

# Member communications

For anything sent to members:

- Write dates in full, including the weekday and year, for example: Saturday 14 November 2026.
- Use the 24-hour clock with leading zeroes, for example: 09:30.
- Use British spelling.
- Do not use exclamation marks.
- Keep the entire communication under 120 words, including the heading and signature.
- Sign exactly "The committee", with no personal names.

Check every member communication against these rules before saving it.

item.text:
Fixed [notice.md](notice.md): removed the exclamation mark and corrected the signature to “The committee”. It meets the house rules and is under 120 words.

Added all six rules to [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), with a reminder to check future member communications before saving.
